title: The Path of Darkness
text: “Hurry up and run for it!”
“O-Oink!”
At the mixed-breed lizardman's voice, the pig nodded and fled.
After the pig had made its escape, the mixed-breed lizardman silently watched the Wave's rift. Then, without much fuss, he cut down a Dimension Ghoul that had wandered close.
“Everyone! Don't scatter—stay together in one place! There are no monsters over here, and someone skilled is guarding it!”

The rabbit man was guiding the villagers to the area where the security net formed by Filolial-sama and myself had been set up, I say. That wasn't what I'd imagined at all. He should be leading them further outside the village, away from the Wave's rift, indeed!
“Oink oink.”

Lazy Pig had produced, from who knows where, a signboard indicating the escape route the rabbit man had designated, and now stood there stock-still holding it up. Just how lazy could one pig possibly be, I ask!
“Air Strike Shield! Shield Prison! Seriously, there's no end to these monsters coming out. Wolf!”
“Wooo-oof!”

Father, riding calmly atop Wolf, was using shields he'd summoned as footholds while issuing attack orders. The sight of him darting about so freely cut quite the impressive figure, I say. With a light thud, Father landed beside the mixed-breed lizardman and dismounted from Wolf.
“With Wolf here, I feel like any stray arrow could come flying our way without warning. Shion, could you go on ahead to where the Wave boss is?”
“……You mean, abandon my post?”
“I do think Ren and Itsuki will finish it off, but Shion, don't you actually want to go?”
“If you've got an answer to give, then go. You're itching to, aren't you? Wolf, you too.”
“Wooo-oof!”
“Father, what should I do?”
“Motoyasu-kun, you want to protect the Filolials, don't you?”

Oh my, he'd already seen through me. Truthfully, what I really wanted was to take down the Dimension Chimera as cleanly as possible. Though if I put in too much force, the meat would go flying everywhere, so I had to be careful with my strength. Precision aim was the key, I say.
“Well……I want to finish this before the kingdom's soldiers arrive. We're running out of time. Shion……”
“……Understood. My thanks for your consideration. Let's go, Wolf!”
“Wooo-oof!”
And so the mixed-breed lizardman and Wolf ran off.
“Haaaaaaaah! Hmph!”
“Vaw!”
The mixed-breed lizardman and Wolf easily cut down a large Dimension Ghoul—the same type Sakura-chan had defeated back in the loop where we'd stayed in Melromarc—and kept right on running.
“Even a large monster, taken down that easily……those two really are something.”
“Theo, do you want to earn some glory too? Even if the kingdom won't recognize it, I'll be watching. You could go report over there if you like.”
“It's not that I have no interest, but there's no room left for me to shine over there. That's how skilled Shion and Wolf are. And with Kuro-san there too, it shouldn't take much longer anyway.”
“I hope you're right.”

“More importantly, what matters is how we protect the panicking villagers without letting them get hurt. Since the soldiers might attack Iwatani-sama, I'd like the villagers to be somewhere the crossfire is likely to reach.”

The rabbit man turned to Father with a smile wrapped in an aura that seemed practically handed down directly from Father himself, I say. That was the same kind of smile Big Sister sometimes gave Father, indeed.
“Theo……you really are something.”
“I think the people of this kingdom are capable of that much, at least. So we protect the villagers while letting them double as witnesses and victims, should the soldiers attack.”
“Sigh……ease up on the scheming a little, would you?”
“I'd like you to think of it as a survival skill.”
“Honestly, your tongue's gotten sharper and sharper, hasn't it.”
“Well, I've been trained by you and the others, Iwatani-sama.”

Heh heh……the rabbit man laughed. Looking off in the distance, I confirmed that the soldiers coming from the castle were……few, indeed. Whatever could be the matter, I wondered? Then I recalled—when we'd first arrived in this loop, I'd been the one to take down the soldiers and that so-called knight captain stationed at the border fortress. Perhaps those losses hadn't been filled in yet? Or maybe soldiers had been mixed in among the Three Heroes Church followers disguised as bandits, leaving the kingdom genuinely short-handed. It seemed more likely that Elephant and Keel's group, who were supposed to arrive with a separate unit, would get here first. Keel, riding Luna-chan, was steadily closing the distance.
“Now then, I wonder if we can wrap this up before Keel-kun and the others arrive. Motoyasu-kun, go ahead and get ready.”
“Understood. Yuki-chan! I leave the escort of Filolial-sama and everyone else to you, I say.”
“Understood!”
Now then, whose back should I ride to the site? No……I suppose I'll do it right here.
“Well then, here I go! Drive Mode—”
“Denied! Motoyasu-kun. That's a performance for another time, you know.”
Gah……Father had warned me not to make my grand debut just yet.
“Well then, Kou, if you would.”
“Ehh, Kou wants to stay and protect these kids, though.”

Kou insisted he wanted to protect the village children. Ohh……this loop's Kou seemed to have a much stronger desire to protect children than in other loops, I say. And to think that back when we'd stayed in Melromarc, he'd just been a little glutton. Perhaps this was the fruit of Elephant's upbringing.
“Kou, you can leave those kids to us.”
“Yes, let's hurry and finish off the Wave. It'll be good motivation to light a fire under Shion and the others.”
“Uu……fine.”
Looking rather reluctant, Kou carried me on his back and took off running. And so we headed toward the Wave's rift.
“Hyah! Dark Holy Hero—God-Demon Annihilation Dark—”
“Don't just make up move names on your own!”
Kuro-chan, carrying Ren on his back, was swiftly toying with the Dimension Chimera while urging Ren to unleash a finishing blow, indeed.
“Vaaaw!”
“Hmph!”
Meanwhile, the mixed-breed lizardman and Wolf each landed a blow squarely on one of the Dimension Chimera's heads, severing them clean off. Quite the power behind those hits, I say.
“Gyaaaaah!”
“They're better than I expected.”
Itsuki, too, seemed to be firing arrows to blind its eyes. It looked like this Wave was proving to be quite the easy win, indeed.
“Alright, here I go!”
Whoosh! Kuro-chan sped past using the acceleration magic that Filolial-sama—Filo-tan included—excelled at.
“G-Gyaaah—!?”
“Boo, it's not God-Demon Annihilation Dark anymore, it turned into God-Demon Slaying Claw.”
“D-Don't go slapping nonsensical move names on things!”

Right after, the Dimension Chimera let out a thud and breathed its last. I made sure to see the finishing touch through properly, I say. Without missing a beat, I struck the Wave's rift and firmly settled the Wave. The wine-red sky vanished, and the heavens cleared up brightly.
“Well, that about does it, I say.”

It seemed they'd finished it off before I even needed to show up. Kuro-chan's growth appeared to be quite something, indeed. As for the mixed-breed lizardman and Wolf, well, at least they hadn't been dead weight, had they?
“What do you mean……ugh……‘that about does it’……”
With a thud, Ren slid right off Kuro-chan's back.
“Ren-sama!”
“Dark Holy Hero, what's wrong?”
“I feel sick……”
Ren proceeded to retch right there on the spot. Ah, this must have been his first time riding on Filolial-sama's back, and he'd gotten motion sick. Ren just lay there afterward, utterly limp.
“That's the noble motion sickness that comes from riding Filolial-sama, I say. It happens because he's not used to it yet.”
“After being flung about so wildly, of course he'd get sick. Honestly, I'm impressed he managed to fight at all without getting thrown off.”
Oh my? Itsuki said this to Ren without a trace of hostility. It seemed Ren had done well riding on Kuro-chan's back. All thanks to Kuro-chan, of course. He ought to be grateful, I say.
“Ohh! Once again, riding on Kuro's back, walking the Path of Darkness—the Dark Legend—as the Dark Holy Hero!”
“Don't……mess around. Urgh……”
“Ren-sama!”
“Uh oh, well then, Kuro will carry you.”
“N-No! I'm fine! I'm perfectly fine! Urgh……alright, let's split up the spoils!”
When Kuro-chan offered to carry him, Ren, still pale-faced, wobbled to his feet and put on a show of being full of energy.
